shots.name: k1
shots.prompt: Wide shot in a small neighbourhood library in soft daylight: tall wooden shelves with completely blank book spines, a reading table with a green lamp. Lena, a young woman of 22 with light brown curly hair tied back, an olive-green cardigan and small round glasses, stands at the table with an open, titleless book in her hands; Kerem, a young man of 24 with short brown hair, a grey hoodie and a backpack, leans on the table beside her. Vertical composition. Vertical composition.

shots.name: k2
shots.prompt: Use the reference image for the characters and the setting: keep the same faces, hair, clothes, colours and lighting. Medium shot across the table: Kerem asks, nodding at the open book, genuinely curious; Lena looks up from the page, finger marking her place. Soft window light, blurred blank spines behind. Vertical composition. Vertical composition.

shots.prompt: Use the reference image for the characters and the setting: keep the same faces, hair, clothes, colours and lighting. Close-up of the table top: Lena's hand slides the plain hardcover book across the wood toward Kerem, pages still open, the green lamp reflected in the polished surface; Kerem's hand reaches to take it. Shallow depth of field. Vertical composition. Vertical composition.
